I mean, I know it's a good length for our attention spans, but I've always wondered when we got the standard length established and why.

Edit: While I appreciate song suggestions, I already know that there are some very long songs, and I have heard plenty of them. I was just curious about the ~3 minute trend.
Why Do Songs Tend to Be ~3 Minutes Long?

That's the length of most radio edits of songs, and a lot of pop musicians have adopted this as the average lengths of their songs. Look around at artists not in the spotlight, you'll see tracks of all different lengths.
The 78 RPM single was exactly 3 minutes long. It became an industry standard in radio and it stuck because radio stations could play more advertisements based on a 3 minute song standard.
